classification.difficultyReason: Recognise supplementary pairs, subtract the polygon interior-angle sum, and generalise the same scaffolded calculation to n sides.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In the convex decagon to the right, each side has been produced to form an exterior angle.

spec.description: Unlabelled convex decagon with ten sides extended consistently beyond their vertices and all ten exterior angles marked. Ordinary source-blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: Each marked exterior angle forms a supplementary pair with the interior angle at the same vertex. No equality marks or numerical angle values are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied polygon, extensions and exterior-angle arcs are visible.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Explain why the sum of the interior angles plus the sum of the exterior angles is $1800^\circ$.

answer.short: Each interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle add to $180^\circ$. There are 10 pairs, so their total is $10\times180^\circ=1800^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Each side extension forms a straight line, so the interior angle and adjacent exterior angle at each vertex are supplementary.

There are 10 vertices, hence the combined sum is $10\times180^\circ=1800^\circ$.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Hence find the sum of the 10 exterior angles.

answer.worked:
The interior-angle sum of the decagon is $(10-2)\times180^\circ=1440^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=1800^\circ-1440^\circ\\\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=360^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw a convex hexagon and repeat the process.

answer.short: Interior plus exterior angles: $1080^\circ$. Interior angles: $720^\circ$. Exterior angles: $360^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Draw a convex hexagon, extend each side in the same turning direction and mark the six exterior angles.

Each interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle are supplementary, so the combined sum is $6\times180^\circ=1080^\circ$.

The interior-angle sum is $(6-2)\times180^\circ=720^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=1080^\circ-720^\circ\\\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=360^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: One example of a convex hexagon with each side extended and all six exterior angles marked.
spec.mathematics: Six supplementary interior/exterior pairs; no regularity assumption is needed for the calculation.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Using the same technique, find the sum of the exterior angles of a convex polygon with $n$ sides.

answer.short:
$360^\circ$.

Subtract the interior-angle sum from the total of the $n$ supplementary interior/exterior pairs.
answer.worked:
The $n$ supplementary pairs have combined sum $180n^\circ$. The interior-angle sum is $180(n-2)^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=180n^\circ-180(n-2)^\circ\\\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=180n^\circ-180n^\circ+360^\circ\\\text{Exterior-angle sum}&=360^\circ\end{align*}$$
